The experience illustrated here, where accounts are created and logged into from settings, is unintuitive and unfamiliar. On mobile, we should instead present with the option to log in or create an account when the app is launched, or offer the opportunity to continue without creating an account.

Thereafter, it should be possible to access account creation/login, or sign out of a logged-in account from settings, but this should generally link the user back to the account register/login page instead of just being an inline form.

Independent QA: **ready** after actual-base impact reassessment. Supersedes [the prior verdict](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/29#issuecomment-6023181559).

Web capture behavior is unaffected, so the existing independently inspected pixels/provenance and passing tests remain applicable. Current-head CI is green.

Existing evidence does not establish this requested flow.

Future ready checks will read and disposition all paginated feedback bodies, then recheck IDs, timestamps and body hashes immediately before publication.

Back/cancel preserves data and settings drafts; guest choices are remembered and saved sign-ins resume directly.

The PR now shows fresh actual-master Before/After captures. Current CI passed, along with five account-browser and 73 guest/offline scenarios. [The human launch/settings request](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/29#issuecomment-6025763278) is resolved at ddad868: dedicated login/create/guest choices, settings navigation and local-preserving signout. I inspected the changed code and all nine fresh images, verified build/fixture provenance, and independently passed two focused browser checks for back/cancel, drafts, offline relaunch and failed persistence. [Immutable detailed verdict, full feedback dispositions and exact bindings](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/701375fa04506f6f83722f9c64a00b5256b14d17/verdict.json). Full conversation/review/inline bodies were rechecked before publication. Rendering is human-waived; native hardware/system-back and real providers remain unperformed. ## Problem and solution

Families need to recover boards and saved media after reinstalling or moving devices without giving up local, offline use. Optional Firebase sign-in enables consent-based backups to the selected server; guest libraries stay local and sign-out keeps downloaded boards.

[Draft PR24](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/24) carries the accounts-only implementation on [PR20](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/20). Review and merge the parent first. Original [PR11](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/11) and its evidence remain preserved; the former unknown-owner hold is resolved by the separately owned continuation.
